biggest_catch: Your friend has to actually qualify for the product — open a new checking account with a $300+ direct deposit within 60 days, or get approved for a vehicle loan ($10k+, 36+ months), credit card ($3k+ limit, one transaction), or home equity product — and then wait 4-6 weeks for the card. A friend who registers but never qualifies earns you nothing, and the page states no cap or expiration.
catches: Friend (Referred Person) must register via the referral link, open the new product, and complete qualifications within the stated timeframe: personal checking — $300+ direct deposit within 60 days; vehicle loan — $10,000+ loan with 36+ month term; credit card — $3,000+ limit and one or more transactions within 60 days; home equity loan — $15,000+ with 5+ year term; HELOC — $15,000+ limit with $4,000+ initial draw.
Both the referrer and the friend receive a $50 Visa Reward Card per qualifying product ('you and the person who referred you will BOTH receive a Visa Reward Card!').
Allow 4-6 weeks after completing qualifications for the Reward Card to arrive.
All offers subject to credit approval; terms and conditions apply.
No stated referral cap and no stated expiration on the fetched page.
No 1099/tax disclosure on the fetched page.

steps: Register for the referral program and share the referral offer with a friend.
Your friend registers via your referral link and opens a new personal checking account, vehicle loan, credit card, or home equity product.
Your friend completes the product qualifications (e.g., $300+ direct deposit within 60 days for checking; loan/credit approval thresholds for other products).
After qualification, you and your friend each receive a $50 Visa Reward Card (allow 4-6 weeks for arrival).
timing: Allow 4-6 weeks after the friend completes qualifications for the $50 Visa Reward Card to arrive.
when_cash_arrives: Allow 4-6 weeks after the friend completes qualifications for the $50 Visa Reward Card to arrive. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
